race.comment: WHISKEY SERVICE (5) had won two in a row before finishing second (19.03) last time at this track. Top chance in this line up. SPRING NICK (4) latest effort finished 6th over 350m at this track beaten 5.5 lengths (19.48) behind Brownlow in a Grade 4 on October 15. Can feature with the right run. STRIKES TWICE (1) settled back off the inside but went through his gears strongly to find the frame with a 0.8 lengths second (19.20) at this track in Mix 5. Will give a great sight again. SAPPHIRE KING (2) is worth including.
